text:
rebecca (Product): Short sync needed. Customer asks: private pilot w/ tenant pinning, per-tenant quota, and audit trail. Breaking into minimal gates so we can schedule. Thoughts? @mike @cheng @lisa

sam (PM): Minimal gates I care about: API for pin/unpin, quota enforcement (soft), telemetry for p95, and an audit stream. Non-goal: full dedicated tenancy for pilot.

mike (Runtime): Runtime hit list: pin metadata in tenant profile, per-tenant KV namespace, and fallback policy. Can do shim layer quickly but need infra slot for prewarm. Estimate: 2 sprints with infra ready.

cheng (Infra): We can provide shared GPUs with reservation labels. Prewarm automation needs a small controller change. ETA for infra work: 10 business days. Also will need network checklist for private VPCs.

lisa (Security): For pilot we can accept KMS with tenant-scoped keys (soft-HSM). Must enable write-once audit logs for pin/unpin events. I'll provide checklist: key rotation, least-priv role, and audit retention.

rahul (SWE): Quick question on quota model: do we want token quotas enforced server-side or client-side billing-only alerts? Enforcement affects runtime path.

mike (Runtime): Prefer server-side soft-enforce (throttle + alert) so we can toggle to hard-enforce later. Adds ~1 API check per request; negligible.

sam (PM): OK soft-enforce. We'll use alerting to notify customer and Ops before hard blocks.

rebecca (Product): Sketching acceptance criteria below — please confirm or call out missing bits:
- Pin API: POST /tenants/{id}/pin {model_id, variant} and DELETE to unpin
- Quotas: soft-enforce tokens/day per tenant + alert webhook
- Telemetry: tenant-dim p50/p95 latency, token usage, fallback rate
- Security: tenant keys in KMS, audit log of pin/unpin and key access
- Infra: reservation label + prewarm config toggle
- Ops: runbook for fallback + quota incidents

mike (Runtime): Confirmed. For the API contract, we'll add response fields: pinned_model, active_cache_ns, fallback_reason. I'll drop a small OpenAPI fragment in the ticket.

cheng (Infra): Confirm reservation label + prewarm toggle. I'll open infra-ticket and link here. Need product approval for 1 A100-eq reserved slot.

lisa (Security): I posted a short checklist: soft-HSM allowed for pilot, but must enable immutable audit logs and encryption-at-rest.

ops-bot: monitor created: tenant-pilot-quota-alerts -> 3 alerts: quota_exhausted, ttl_warning, fallback_rate_high

rebecca (Product): Thanks. Next steps: @sam assemble a 1-pager + rollout steps (2 tenants -> 5 -> 20) and link to infra ticket. If infra confirms slot this week we can schedule runtime sprint next cycle. Quick thumbs if aligned. :thumbsup:

sam (PM): will do. I'll wire the API fragment and rollout timeline by EOD.

mike (Runtime): ack, will size tasks and add to sprint backlog.

cheng (Infra): ack  opening ticket now.

lisa (Security): ack, I'll join the design review on Thu.

rahul (SWE): noted. I'll prototype the quota-check hook for runtime tests.

rebecca (Product): Great, closing the loop here. If any blocker surfaces ping this thread and we'll call the Monday triage.
